clue.text: Latitude given to refreshment areas in the gymnasium

parts.note: lines of latitude are the parallels, so a parallel is a line of latitude
bars are places serving drinks and snacks

explanation.surface: A lax regime lets drinks counters into the school gym.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Latitude' reads as freedom, but here it is a line of latitude, a parallel.
explanation.definitionFit: This apparatus of two raised horizontal rails is standard gymnastics equipment.

clue.text: Hardy lass understands horror writer if she is well-versed

indicators.note: read as under-stands: the heroine stands below the writer in this down entry

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe wrote tales of horror
Tess of the d'Urbervilles is a Thomas Hardy heroine

explanation.surface: A Hardy heroine grasps Poe's horror stories.
explanation.walkthrough: 'understands' means stands under, putting TESS beneath POE.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman skilled in verse is a female poet.

clue.text: Correct pronunciation for the ceremony

indicators.note: pronunciation signals that a word is to be said out loud

parts.note: correct means right

explanation.surface: How to say the words properly at a formal ritual.
explanation.definitionFit: A rite is a formal religious or ceremonial act.

clue.text: A game dog, but unsteady on his feet

definitions.meaning: a crossbred hunting dog used for catching game
one who staggers or lurches

explanation.definitionFit: The crossbred hound chases hares, and one who staggers about lurches.

clue.text: Suffer insults when wrongly attired

indicators.note: wrongly tells us these letters are set in an incorrect order

explanation.surface: Being mocked for being badly dressed.
explanation.definitionFit: To eat dirt is an idiom for accepting humiliation meekly.

clue.text: Prohibit a thousand pound note issuer

parts.note: to prohibit is to ban
K stands for a thousand, as in pounds

explanation.surface: Forbidding a grand to whoever prints banknotes.
explanation.definitionFit: Banknotes are issued by a central or commercial bank.

clue.text: Shook the collecting box, being disconcerted

definitions.meaning: made the coins jingle
unsettled or flustered

explanation.definitionFit: Shaking coins makes a clatter, and an unsettled person is said to be shaken up.

clue.text: Do feminists prefer it to the fatherland?

definitions.text: Do feminists prefer it to the fatherland?

parts.words: Do feminists prefer it to the fatherland?
parts.note: a playful thought that feminists might rename their homeland with a female parent

explanation.definitionFit: One's native land is called by a maternal term as well as fatherland.

clue.text: Declare belief in antidisestablishmentarianism!

parts.note: to declare is to state
a religion is a system of belief

explanation.surface: Proclaim faith in the famously long-winded doctrine.
explanation.walkthrough: Antidisestablishmentarianism opposed removing the Church of England's official status.
explanation.definitionFit: The doctrine defends an established church, an officially endorsed faith.

clue.text: Hardly the hotel for a singular stage celebrity

parts.note: singular means one in number
a star is a famous performer

explanation.surface: A lone famous actor would not choose a modest hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: Hotels are graded by stars, and the lowest grading is hardly a hotel worth the name.

clue.text: Nip for a young nipper

definitions.meaning: a nip is a very small drink of spirits
a nipper is a small child

explanation.definitionFit: A tiny tot is both a little measure of liquor and a toddler.

clue.text: Ambassador going to the Spanish part of Italy

parts.note: an ambassador is styled His Excellency, abbreviated HE
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A diplomat heads to the Spanish-speaking region of Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: On a map Italy is shaped like a boot, so its southern tip is the heel.
explanation.definitionFit: The boot-shaped peninsula has a toe and a heel, the latter being Apulia's tip.

clue.text: Tea stock has arrived for a lot of supermarkets

parts.note: cha is slang for tea, here a supply of it
something that has arrived is in

explanation.surface: Fresh tea supplies reach the supermarket.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of shops under one owner is called a chain.

clue.text: Fool acquires third-rate item at auction

parts.note: C is the third grade after A and B
each item put up at an auction is a lot

explanation.surface: An idiot buys a shoddy piece in the saleroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A clot is British slang for a stupid person, a dimwit.

clue.text: Petty cash required for milk delivery

definitions.meaning: a sum kept for small change and expenses
a milk ... is a British electric delivery van

explanation.definitionFit: A till float is starting change, and British milkmen drove electric floats.

clue.text: First-rate corned beef

definitions.meaning: a dated word meaning excellent
... beef is tinned corned beef

explanation.definitionFit: 'Bully for you' means splendid, and soldiers' tinned corned beef was called bully beef.

clue.text: One who takes stock when king partitions Ulster

parts.note: R stands for rex, Latin for king

indicators.note: partitions suggests dividing up and redistributing these letters

explanation.surface: A monarch divides the Northern Irish province.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stock' here is livestock, not shop goods; ULSTER, the northern Irish province, plus R is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A cattle thief steals livestock, the stock of a farm.

clue.text: Boom time a German gets embarrassed over

parts.note: Hun is a dated slang term for a German

indicators.note: over signals the word for embarrassed is turned around

parts.note: an embarrassed person goes red

explanation.surface: A German blushes as time goes by.
explanation.definitionFit: A boom is a deep resounding noise, like a peal of thunder.

clue.text: Adept shaken by visitor to geriatric ward

definitions.meaning: an adept is an expert, a veteran

definitions.text: shaken by visitor to geriatric ward
definitions.meaning: a visitor shakes an elderly patient's hand

explanation.definitionFit: An expert is a veteran, and an elderly patient's hand is literally aged.

clue.text: One who beats out old copper and glass

parts.note: D was the abbreviation for an old British penny, a copper coin
a rummer is a large drinking glass

explanation.surface: A thief knocks out old pennies and glasses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' is the old penny, not a policeman.
explanation.definitionFit: A percussionist beats out the rhythm.

clue.text: Conscript places primitive vessel in Scottish river

indicators.note: in tells us the vessel goes inside the river's name

parts.note: the Dee flows through Aberdeenshire
a raft is a basic floating craft

explanation.surface: A recruit launches a crude boat on a Highland river.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone called up for military service is a drafted soldier.

clue.text: Grip Don't let anything drop

definitions.meaning: a grip is a travelling bag
an order to keep hold of everything

explanation.definitionFit: A grip is a large carrying bag, and to keep everything in hand is to hold it all.

clue.text: Sound as if there's no land for the Vatican

indicators.note: sound as if tells us the phrase is to be heard spoken

parts.note: if there is no land, everything is water, wholly sea

explanation.surface: It seems the whole world is underwater.
explanation.definitionFit: The papal government based in Rome is known as the Holy See.

clue.text: A priest one is able to describe as a continental

parts.note: Fr is short for Father, a priest's title
I is the Roman numeral for one
can means is able

explanation.surface: A cleric can call himself a European.
explanation.walkthrough: 'continental' looks like European but means a native of the African continent.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from that southern continent is described by its adjective.

clue.text: Reason for veto by America

parts.note: a veto is a no
US is short for the United States

explanation.surface: Why the United States would block a motion.
explanation.definitionFit: Nous is common sense or practical intelligence, the faculty of reason.

clue.text: Make a comeback in the tennis game

definitions.meaning: to recover strength or position
an exchange of shots before a point is won

explanation.definitionFit: To recover is to rally, and a prolonged exchange of strokes in tennis is a rally.

clue.text: Overdress and boast of it

definitions.meaning: to dress showily, an old sense of flaunting finery
to talk proudly about something

explanation.definitionFit: Showing off in fine clothes and crowing about them are both forms of vaunting.

clue.text: Dancing habit of an Anglican bishop

definitions.meaning: a ballerina's short stiff skirt
Desmond ..., archbishop of Cape Town

explanation.definitionFit: A ballet dancer's skirt shares its name with the South African archbishop.

clue.text: They are handed to belligerents

parts.note: weapons are supplied to fighters, and limbs end in hands

explanation.definitionFit: Weapons are given to fighting sides, and upper limbs carry hands.

clue.text: Horse in reverse for tour men organised

indicators.note: organised means these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A spare mount is arranged for the riders on the trek.
explanation.definitionFit: A remount is a fresh horse supplied to replace a tired one.

clue.text: Knighted colonel turns to company getting wind up

parts.note: a knight is addressed as Sir

indicators.note: turns signals that the colonel's letters run backwards

parts.note: CO is commanding officer, the post a colonel holds

explanation.surface: A knighted colonel joins a firm and gets nervous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' reverses CO to OC. 'Getting the wind up' is British slang for becoming scared, which masks the meteorological wind.
explanation.definitionFit: The sirocco is a hot dusty Mediterranean wind blowing from North Africa.

clue.text: Complaint by ship's lad after the Glorious Twelfth

parts.note: a grouse is a grumble
a boy of the ocean, playfully a son of the sea

explanation.surface: A cabin boy grumbles once mid-August arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: The Glorious Twelfth is 12 August, when shooting of the game bird begins in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Shooting of red game birds is legal in Britain from the Glorious Twelfth onwards.
